title: White business cards with a blue striped-M logo, shown as a stack in hard light and standing with a laser-cutting photo
whatItIs: Two rounded panels: a black-to-grey scene with a thick stack of white cards printed with a blue striped monogram and a two-tone name, and a grey concrete corner with a card standing that includes phone, '20 years of experience', a service title, orange stars and a photo of a laser cutter.
whatItMeans: Reliable and precise; a striped monogram and a machine photo signal metalwork.
techniques: Use a service photo inside the card.
Keep the colour to blue with one orange.

vocabulary.definition: Business cards piled to show thickness.
